name: land
title: Land and habitat media profile
description: Environmental media documenting land cover, habitat structure, and landscape change. Use with rpdp when the same location is photographed repeatedly from a fixed point.
alignmentNote: alignments are a core optional table for any corresponding-scene pair, including marked repeat-photo stakes.
notes: Code landCoverClass with measurementScheme (corine, nlcd, esa-worldcover, osm, or a documented custom scheme).
Set deployments.fixedPoint=true and reuse locationID for marked repeat-photo stakes.
